summary: Tested the RFQ/RFP templates and the vendor Messages unread badge. Backend: 12 of 12 tests pass in the new file tests/test_r14_rfq_rfp_unread.py. (1) The masters are seeded: kind=rfq returns 'Standard Request for Quotation (RFQ)' with sections rfq-1..rfq-6, rfq-form-A and rfq-form-B in order; kind=rfp returns 'Standard Request for Proposal (RFP)' with 10 sections. The vendor can see the masters too. (2) Seeding is idempotent: after a backend restart, Mongo still has exactly 1 seeded master each for rfq, rfp and tender. (3) Cloning (as admin) keeps kind rfq/rfp, and GET confirms it. (4) AI draft uses the real LLM. RFQ section rfq-4 gave about 290 words on price basis, taxes, currency, validity and L1 award. RFP section rfp-6 gave about 273 words: QCBS 80:20, technical criteria with point weights, and an invitation to propose an approach and methodology. A bad section code returns 404. (5) GET /vendor/messages/unread-count returns 401 without auth and 401/403 for an admin session. It returns {unread:N} for the vendor, counts only that vendor's messages, and drops by 1 after POST /read. UI: admin /admin/e/tender-builder: the RFQ and RFP tabs each show their single master. 'Clone as draft' creates a draft listed as '8 sections · RFQ' or '10 sections · RFP' and shows a success toast. Vendor: with one TEST_ unread message, the left-nav Messages badge (vendor-nav-count-vendor-messages) shows 1 with the hot class. Opening /vendor/messages and clicking the message opens the body, and the badge disappears without a reload. Unread (0) is shown, there is still no badge after reload and on /vendor, and with 0 unread no badge renders. All TEST_ messages and the cloned drafts were deleted.

minor.issue: It counts only {read: False}, but GET /vendor/messages counts `not m.get('read')`. A message inserted without a 'read' field would show in the inbox count but not in the badge. Use {'read': {'$ne': True}} for consistency.
kind is a free str (description 'tender | rfp | rfq') with no Literal validation, so any value is accepted. An unknown kind silently falls back to tender style in kind_style.

issues: RFQ/RFP drafts still show the PSU e-tender 'Basic Details' grid: Tender Type 'Open Tender', 3 covers including 'Bid declaration for EMD', Form of Contract EOI and Tender Category Works. For a short RFQ this is heavy and not in RFQ style. Consider kind-specific header defaults, e.g. 1 cover for an RFQ and 2 envelopes for an RFP.

action_items: Optional: make unread-count use {'read': {'$ne': True}} to match the list endpoint.
Optional: give RFQ/RFP drafts kind-appropriate header defaults (covers, tender type) in the editor.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_master_templates(force=True) (admin POST /tender-templates/seed) deletes all seed masters, including RFQ/RFP, and recreates them with new _ids. Existing drafts are unaffected, but any stored reference to a master id becomes stale. This is acceptable but worth noting.
TenderBuilderPanel.jsx is 842 lines and should be split further.
The VendorPortalChrome badge logic hides the Messages badge only when the count is 0. The other nav items still show 0, which is intended.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ messages for VEN-TEST01, plus 2 TEST_R14 drafts and 2 UI-cloned drafts. All were deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: pytest tests/test_r14_rfq_rfp_unread.py -n 0 (it uses the real LLM, about 20s). Vendor UI login works on /login (Supplier, the default) or /vendor/login; wait for hydration before filling. The admin Tender Builder is at /admin/e/tender-builder, with testids tb-kind-{rfq|rfp}, tb-master-{id}, tb-clone-{id} and tb-draft-meta-{id}. UI clones are named '<master name> — draft YYYY-MM-DD' (no TEST_ prefix), so delete them by name.
